arabic text: ZINDAN KHUL GAYA HAI
english translation text: THE PRISON HAS OPENED

arabic text: ZINDAN KHUL GAYA HAI, SAKINA, WATAN CHALO
english translation text: THE PRISON HAS OPENED, SAKINA, LET’S GO HOME.

arabic text: SAJJAD KEH KE GIR PADE CHOTI SI QABR PAR...
english translation text: SAJJAD SAID THIS AND COLLAPSED UPON THE SMALL GRAVE...

arabic text: MAZLOOM AISE GIR PADA TURBAT PE BEHAN KI
english translation text: THE OPPRESSED BROTHER FELL ON HIS SISTER’S GRAVE,

arabic text: JAISA HUSSAIN THE GIRE AKBAR KI LASH PAR...
english translation text: JUST LIKE HUSSAIN FELL UPON AKBAR’S LIFELESS BODY...

arabic text: DEKHO NAHI RAHI MERE HAATHON MEIN AB RASAN
english translation text: LOOK, THE ROPES ARE NO LONGER ON MY HANDS,

arabic text: JAANE LAGA HAI QAFILA AB LAUT KAR WATAN
english translation text: THE CARAVAN IS NOW RETURNING HOME,

arabic text: LEKIN TU BEHAN, SHAAM MEIN QAIDI HI REH GAYI
english translation text: BUT YOU, SISTER, REMAINED A PRISONER IN SHAAM,

arabic text: KHA KAR TAMACHAY SO GAYI ZINDAAN KI KHAAK PAR...
english translation text: AFTER BEARING SLAPS, YOU FELL ASLEEP ON THE PRISON'S DUST...

arabic text: KARTA HOON YAAD RO KE MAIN MANZAR WOH DARD KA
english translation text: I CRY REMEMBERING THAT PAINFUL SCENE,

arabic text: KAANO KE ZAKHAM PAR JO TAMACHA TUJHE LAGA
english translation text: WHEN A SLAP STRUCK YOUR WOUNDED EAR,

arabic text: BABA KO TU SEENA PE SADA DETI REH GAYI
english translation text: YOU KEPT CALLING BABA UPON YOUR CHEST,

arabic text: BABA SEENA PE ROTAY THEY TAB TUJH KO DEKH KAR...
english translation text: AND BABA WOULD WEEP, SEEING YOU, HOLDING HIS CHEST...

arabic text: AMMA KI TARHA TUJH KO NA MIL PAYI THI RIDA
english translation text: LIKE OUR MOTHER, YOU WERE DENIED A VEIL,

arabic text: BABA KI TARHA TUJH KO KAFAN BHI NA MIL SAKA
english translation text: LIKE OUR FATHER, YOU WEREN'T EVEN GIVEN A SHROUD,

arabic text: PATHAR BHI KHAYE SHAAM MEIN TU NE MERI TARAH
english translation text: YOU TOO WERE PELTED WITH STONES IN SHAAM LIKE ME,

arabic text: NAQAY SE GIR KE HO GAYI TERI BHI KHAM QAMAR...
english translation text: AND FALLING FROM THE CAMEL, YOUR BACK BENT AS WELL...

arabic text: MAIN LE KE TUJH KO SHAAM SE WAPIS NA JA SAKA
english translation text: I COULD NOT TAKE YOU BACK FROM SHAAM,

arabic text: BABA KO KYA BATAOON MAIN AB JA KE KARBALA
english translation text: WHAT SHALL I TELL BABA WHEN I REACH KARBALA NOW?

arabic text: KURTAY MEIN DAFN KAR KE BANAI TERI LEHAD
english translation text: I BURIED YOU IN YOUR TORN SHIRT AND BUILT YOUR GRAVE,

arabic text: ABID KO KHOON RULAYE GA YEH DARD UMR BHAR...
english translation text: THIS PAIN WILL MAKE ABID CRY BLOOD FOR LIFE...

arabic text: KARBAL MEIN CHHIN GAYI THI TERE SAR SE JO RIDA
english translation text: THE VEIL THAT WAS TORN FROM YOUR HEAD IN KARBALA,

arabic text: WAPAS MAIN LA CHUKA HOON USAY DEKH TU ZARA
english translation text: I’VE BROUGHT IT BACK—LOOK AT IT NOW,

arabic text: SAR PAR MAIN TERE RAKHTA RIDA APNE HAATH SE
english translation text: I PLACE IT UPON YOUR HEAD WITH MY OWN HANDS,

arabic text: AFSOS HAYE SHAAM MEIN TU NA RAHI MAGAR...
english translation text: ALAS, YOU'RE NOT HERE ANYMORE IN SHAAM...

arabic text: AMMA KE BAIN SUN KE NIKALTI HAI JAAN MERI
english translation text: HEARING MOTHER’S CRIES TAKES THE LIFE OUT OF ME,

arabic text: KEHTI HAI UMR BHAR NA WOH SAAYE MEIN JAYE GI
english translation text: SHE SAYS: 'SHE WILL NEVER SIT IN SHADE AGAIN…'

arabic text: KAISE UTHAOON UJDI HUI MAA KO TU BATA
english translation text: TELL ME HOW TO LIFT THIS SHATTERED MOTHER,

arabic text: TERI LEHAD SE MAA KI BHI HATTI NAHI NAZAR...
english translation text: SHE CANNOT TAKE HER EYES OFF YOUR GRAVE...

arabic text: WOH RUKHSAT-E-HUSSAIN PE ZAINAB KA IMTEHAAN
english translation text: THAT TRIAL OF ZAINAB AT HUSSAIN’S FAREWELL,

arabic text: AISA HI AAJ PHIR SE HAI ZINDAN KA SAMAA
english translation text: THE PRISON SCENE IS THE SAME AGAIN TODAY,

arabic text: SAJJAD HO RAHE HAIN JUDA AISE BEHEN SE
english translation text: SAJJAD PARTS FROM HIS SISTER ONCE MORE,

arabic text: UTHTE HAIN RO KE QABR SE, GIRTE HAIN QABR PAR...
english translation text: RISING IN TEARS FROM THE GRAVE, COLLAPSING BACK UPON IT...

arabic text: LIKHOO SHAHAB KIS TARAH MEHSHAR KA MARHALA
english translation text: HOW CAN I DESCRIBE THE SCENE OF JUDGEMENT?

arabic text: THA GHAM KI INTEHA PE BHI ABID KA HOSLA
english translation text: EVEN AT SORROW’S PEAK, ABID SHOWED RESOLVE,

arabic text: ZINDA BEHAN KI QABR SE UTH KAR CHALE GAYA
english translation text: HE ROSE FROM THE GRAVE OF HIS LIVING SISTER,

arabic text: AHWAL-E-GHAM SUNANAY KO BABA KI QABR PAR...
english translation text: TO NARRATE THE STATE OF GRIEF AT BABA’S GRAVE...

arabic text: WAPIS MAIN LA CHUKA HOON OSSAY DEKH TU ZARRA
english translation text: I HAVE NOW BROUGHT IT BACK; LOOK AT IT FOR A MOMENT.
